subject.title: Bug: Billing error (402) causes infinite retry death spiral for inline-apiKey providers (no backoff)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt provider-level fail-closed cooldown state for inline `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` credentials?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the durable inline-key usage namespace and fail-closed behavior change existing inline-key upgrade semantics and need maintainer intent before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
options.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys receive the same billing/auth cooldown protection as profile-backed credentials.

options.title: Keep cooldowns profile-only
options.body: Document migration from inline keys to auth profiles as the supported workaround and close the implementation path as not planned.

options.title: Request narrower design
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers specify the exact cooldown identity, persistence, and recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
recommendation.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys receive the same billing/auth cooldown protection as profile-backed credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: Among the observed candidates, this handle has the strongest mix of adjacent auth/provider history and issue-routing signal for the product-direction choice.
